snippet.title: Odyssey of Dremid'ir | OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
WISHLIST + PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2134530/Odyssey_of_Dremidir/

In the desolate realm of Dremid'ir, abandoned by god-like architects, a fragile world teeters on the edge of oblivion. Unearth secrets in ancient ruins, navigate lost civilizations, and join a band of unsung heroes fighting for survival amidst savage wastelands.
------
To coincide with our new demo update, we're very happy to announce a new trailer for the game, showing off just about everything we've accomplished since our Next Fest attendance last year in June!
